posts.subject: Knife server suggestion
posts.bodyHtml: Ok I don't know how to explain this very good but you could add the rules when you join the server, like when you choose the map when a vote is in progress, but with rules there.. I want this because a lot of players don't read the rules on html and that would be good for new players..

Every time someone joins the server they get a pop up with the rules but most of the players don't read them and just close the pop up.


Every time you join server you agree to the certain rules which are for that server even if you read them or not, that's why I suggest to players to read rules by giving link to forum post or tell them NOT to close the pop up.

Hey Jokah,


thanks for your suggestion. We're going to overthink your idea, but as OxygeN said the players need to read the rules anyways if they want to play on the server. Otherwise they may be force to by a Staffmember.


I think there are some downsites aswell, because it could be annoying to the Stamm Users to dismiss the rules when joining the server or switching the map.


Stay tuned for any further informations about you suggestion. We'll reply to you in this thread again [;-)]


Best regards,
wickedy
